_about: In-app language picker (DESIGN.md D15). Owner: App shell agent; Settings reuses LanguagePickerView.

language.en.comment: Language option. Always written in its own language.

language.system.comment: Language option that follows the device (Vietnamese when the storefront or region is Vietnam).

language.system_sheets_note.en: System screens such as the camera permission and purchases always follow your iPhone's language.
language.system_sheets_note.vi: Các hộp thoại của hệ thống, như xin quyền camera và mua gói, luôn theo ngôn ngữ của iPhone.

language.system_with_current.comment: Language option 'System' followed by the language it currently resolves to, e.g. 'System (English)'.

language.vi.comment: Language option. Always written in its own language.
